title: Glowing ice cream cone
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- cone -->
  <polygon points='38,55 62,55 50,92' fill='#E8A33D'/>
  <polygon points='38,55 50,55 50,92' fill='#F5C86E'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='62' x2='58' y2='62' stroke='#C47A1E' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='43' y1='70' x2='57' y2='70' stroke='#C47A1E' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='45' y1='78' x2='55' y2='78' stroke='#C47A1E' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='55' x2='50' y2='90' stroke='#C47A1E' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='55' x2='50' y2='90' stroke='#C47A1E' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- bottom scoop (chocolate) -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='15' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='45' r='5' fill='#A8764F'/>
  <!-- middle scoop (strawberry) -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='13' fill='#F26D9C'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='33' r='4' fill='#FF9DBE'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='38' r='3' fill='#FF9DBE'/>
  <!-- top scoop (mint) -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='24' r='11' fill='#7DE8C0'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='21' r='3.5' fill='#B4F5DF'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='24' r='2.5' fill='#B4F5DF'/>
  <!-- cherry -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='13' r='4' fill='#E33248'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='12' r='1.5' fill='#FF7A8A'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='9' x2='53' y2='5' stroke='#7DD87D' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- glow dots -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#FFF6A0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#FFF6A0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='20' r='1.5' fill='#FFF6A0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#FFF6A0' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
